Production code must not contain non-documentation comments.

Back to STXFORMAT rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Production code must not contain non-documentation comments. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Source formatting family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXFORMAT010: Production code must not contain non-documentation comments.
// Submit the student.
Submit(student);

Good code example

// Follows STXFORMAT010
/// <summary>Submits an student.</summary>
ValueTask SubmitStudent(Student student) => default;
